title: Mesa de Passagem — v2
prompt:
Create a polished, high-fidelity desktop web app UI mockup for the Portuguese operations dashboard "Dashboard Geral", landscape 16:10, viewport 1600x1000. This is a design proposal image, no browser chrome and no Safari/desktop frame. Preserve the existing product name and current navigation labels. Use a refined dispatcher shift-handover board visual language: warm white workspace, graphite typography, cobalt blue selection, small amber emphasis, precise hairline dividers, compact data-dense layout, highly legible, calm and operational, not generic SaaS gradients.

CRITICAL: the global header and complete operational filter are mandatory and must be visible at the top, not summarized into pills. Header has breadcrumb "Principal › Visão Geral" at left; centered city update ticker with green refresh icon + label "Sincronizado" and a clipped horizontally scrolling line of city/date pairs exactly like "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", with subtle fading edges to communicate horizontal scroll; on right show theme toggle and avatar/profile control. City/date pairs are illustrative demo placeholders. Clearly separate ticker from filters.

Immediately below header show a full-width two-row filter panel with all text crisp and visible. Row 1: label "Período", two-segment switch "Ano/Semana" (selected) and "Intervalo", select "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07". Row 2: selects "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", plus text button "Limpar". This is the real filter set; do not omit any controls or turn them into a summary sentence.

Below filters, left sidebar with the exact existing nav groups and labels:
Principal: Visão Geral (selected), Análise, UTR, Comparação.
Operacional: Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado.
Marketing: Operacional Marketing, Marketing.
Main page title "Resumo Operacional", small context "Ano 2026 · Semanas 05, 06, 07". Three key metric cards in one row: "Corridas ofertadas" 18.450, "Aderência" 74,8%, "Praças" 2. One prominent clean chart titled "Evolução diária", simple two series/legend "Ofertadas" and "Aceitas". A compact table titled "Por praça" with rows Guarulhos, Centro, Total and columns Corridas, Aderência. Ensure balanced useful hierarchy, enough room for all components and legible Portuguese copy. Show full dashboard, page scroll can continue below but do not hide the filters.

No airport imagery, no new features, no invented status labels, no fake alerts, no browser mock chrome. All data are illustrative mock values, not live product data.
demoData: Métricas e pares cidade/data são demonstrativos, não dados do Supabase.
